title: When the selected window reaches today and today has not been recorded yet, the report values the current live stock
refs: specs/inventory-value.md Story 5 S5-R3; §3 Key Decisions (live fallback for today)
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Today's nightly snapshot has not yet been recorded (the normal daytime state).
3. A ZZAUTOTEST part's on-hand quantity was changed TODAY (after last night's capture).
custom_steps:
1. Select a range that reaches today (for example "This Month" or "Today").
2. Find the part whose quantity changed today and read its row.
custom_expected:
1. The report values the current live stock — the values represent today.
2. The part's row reflects today's changed quantity (not yesterday's snapshot), proving the live fallback is in use.
